content.value_statement: Next.js 15 changes component boundaries, caching, and routing behavior, which can create build errors. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through correct App Router patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains Server Component and Client Component boundaries for Next.js 15.
Provides App Router examples for pages, layouts, route handlers, and dynamic routes.
Documents data fetching, streaming, caching, and revalidation patterns.
Guides Server Action forms, validation, optimistic updates, and redirects.
Covers metadata, Open Graph, robots, sitemap, and structured data patterns.
Includes a local Python validator for common Next.js pattern mistakes.
limitations: It does not replace official Next.js documentation for changes after its packaged source version.
The validator uses static string checks and can miss framework-specific edge cases.
Examples use placeholder domains and require adaptation to a real application.
It does not run builds, tests, or dependency upgrades by itself.

use_cases.title: Plan App Router Pages
use_cases.description: Design routes, layouts, loading states, error boundaries, and dynamic segments before implementation.

use_cases.title: Implement Server Actions
use_cases.description: Create mutation flows with validation, redirects, cache revalidation, and optimistic interface updates.

use_cases.title: Review Next.js Patterns
use_cases.description: Check component boundaries, fetch cache choices, metadata coverage, and common migration mistakes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic App Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Next.js 15 specialist skill to plan a new App Router page for [feature]. Include the route structure, component type choices, and loading or error states.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Component Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this component plan for Next.js 15: [describe components]. Decide which parts should be Server Components or Client Components and explain each decision.

prompt_templates.title: Design Fetching and Caching
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the data fetching, caching, revalidation, and streaming approach for this App Router feature: [describe feature and freshness needs].

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Feature Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Next.js 15 feature plan for Server Actions, metadata, cache behavior, security boundaries, and validator coverage: [paste plan].

output_examples.input: Review my product detail page plan for Next.js 15.
output: A route structure using dynamic segments and shared layouts.
A Server Component default with isolated Client Components for interactions.
A cache plan for product data, reviews, and personalized user state.

output_examples.input: Help implement a project creation Server Action.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a concise implementation plan covering form submission, validation, authentication, database mutation, redirect behavior, and cache revalidation.

output_examples.input: Explain how to fix unclear fetch caching in a dashboard.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies each data source, assigns explicit cache behavior, and explains when to use no-store, force-cache, revalidation, or tags.

best_practices: Start with Server Components and add Client Components only for interactivity.
Choose explicit cache behavior for every server-side fetch.
Run the validator after changing routes, actions, metadata, or component boundaries.
anti_patterns: Do not mark whole route trees as client components without a browser-only need.
Do not place secrets or private environment variables in Client Components.
Do not copy placeholder API URLs into production without review.

faq.question: Which AI tools does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through guidance files and compatible marketplace metadata.

faq.question: Does this skill execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents an optional local validator, but command execution depends on the host agent and user permissions.

faq.question: Can it help migrate an existing Next.js app?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide App Router patterns, component boundaries, caching choices, and metadata updates during migration.

faq.question: Does it cover Server Actions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for forms, validation, redirects, revalidation, optimistic updates, authentication, and rate limiting.

faq.question: Are the examples production ready?
faq.answer: They are implementation patterns. Replace placeholder domains, adapt validation, and test behavior in your own application.

faq.question: How current is the Next.js guidance?
faq.answer: The guidance is based on the packaged skill files. Verify official Next.js documentation for releases after this package.
